import os, pathlib, json, fcntl
jobs=[]
unreadable=0
for p in pathlib.Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdigit() or int(p.name)==os.getpid(): continue
 try:
  args=(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().replace(bytes([0]),b' ').decode('utf-8','replace')
 except (OSError,PermissionError):
  unreadable+=1
  continue
 if ('autotuner campaign' in args or ('/var/tmp/matrix-autotuner-' in args and ('candidate' in args or '/reference' in args))): jobs.append({'pid':int(p.name),'command':args})
lock='/var/tmp/matrix-autotuner-p3-10245102457.runner.lock'
state='unknown'
try:
 with open(lock,'rb') as stream:
  try:
   fcntl.flock(stream,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
   state='available'
   fcntl.flock(stream,fcntl.LOCK_UN)
  except BlockingIOError: state='held'
except FileNotFoundError: state='absent'
print(json.dumps({'formal_processes':jobs,'unreadable_process_count':unreadable,'runner_lock':lock,'runner_lock_state':state,'pause_marker_action':'none','settings_modified':False}))
